name: Wynn Las Vegas and Encore
positioning: Resort pairing Wynn Las Vegas and the all-suite Encore, with its own Tom Fazio-designed golf course, at 3131 Las Vegas Blvd. South
best_for: Travelers who want a golf course on site
Suite seekers who want Encore's all-suite experience or a Wynn Tower Suite with its private pool deck

facts.text: Wynn Las Vegas and Encore is at 3131 Las Vegas Blvd. South in Las Vegas.
Encore Panoramic View rooms are on floors 31 through 63.
The Encore Three Bedroom Duplex has two-story windows and billiard, dining and exercise rooms.
Wynn's Fairway Villa comes in one- or two-bedroom configurations with a private patio or balcony.
Rooms and suites are designed in soft, subtle hues with layered lighting, by Wynn Design & Development, led by president and chief creative officer Todd-Avery Lenahan.
The art in the rooms and suites was all commissioned for Wynn.
The Wynn pools are temperature-controlled and surrounded by gardens and cabanas.
Encore Beach Club has pools surrounded by daybeds and private cabanas.
Clean Market IV Drip Lounge offers IV nutrient therapy on the Spa level at Wynn.
The Barbershop at Wynn, next to The Salon at Wynn, uses Truefitt & Hill products.
Mizumi serves Japanese cuisine, sushi, robata and teppanyaki beside a 90-foot waterfall.

highlights.text: Wynn Golf Club is a Tom Fazio-designed course with lush greens and rushing streams.
Wynn Tower Suites guests get an exclusive entrance, a daily breakfast credit and a private pool deck.
AFT Cocktail Deck is set along the Lake of Dreams with front-row views of Wynn's nightly show.
Wynn Panoramic Corner King rooms have two walls of floor-to-ceiling windows and are on the 28th floor and above.
The casinos at Wynn and Encore have sky-lit art and floral-filled galleries.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the location at the north end of the Strip means travel to reach other casino areas.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
Wynn and Encore are casino resorts, with casinos at both hotels.
